text:
jamie: Quick heads-up — opened a PR to refresh the starter quickstart auth examples and minimal deployment flow: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/624. Focus: SDK8 examples, ephemeral key snippet, cleaner env examples, and one small Docker note.
priya: Nice. Main goals? Reduce friction for new devs, yes? :sparkles:
jamie: Exactly. Also remove the old token file pattern and add a short ‘rotating keys’ note under Security. Checklist is in the PR description.
alex: Quick skim — curl example has a header typo. Should be `Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY>` not `Auth:`.
jamie: Good catch, fixing in a sec.
ci-bot: CI started for PR #624 — running docs build, linkcheck, snippet-tests.
lina: @jamie can we add a one-line pointer to the KMS guide for customers who want rotation + HSM? Just a link and 1–2 sentences is fine.
jamie: Yep, adding a concise KMS pointer under Security notes.
priya: Also please switch the sample to the SDK8 async example, e.g.: ```python
from redwood import AsyncClient
import os
client = AsyncClient(api_key=os.getenv('RW_API_KEY'))
resp = await client.generate("Hello world")
print(resp.text)
```
alex: snippet-tests failing on Windows runner — the bash example uses `sed -i` without a backup flag. Breaks on mac/win. Suggest `sed -i.bak` or use `python -c` for the inline replace to be cross-platform.
jamie: Replaced the sed line with an awk fallback and added a short note about cross-platform snippet portability. Pushed update.
ci-bot: snippet-tests failed on macos runner, logs: https://ci.redwood-inference.internal/624/logs/snippet-tests.
lina: I'll debug the macos issue tomorrow AM. If it's just sed variants, we can gate the snippet with a comment and offer both one-liners.
alex: Content LGTM otherwise. Small style nit: change heading "first deploy" -> "first deployment" to match style guide.
priya: Approved from docs/UX side :thumbsup: 
jamie: Thanks! Merging once CI goes green.
ci-bot: All checks passed — PR #624 is mergeable.
jamie: Merged PR #624 and deployed staging site. @lina can you sanity-check the KMS link + rotation blurb on staging?
lina: On it — saw a tiny wording tweak needed; expanded the KMS note to include the platform KMS page and pushed a tiny content commit to the site branch.
jamie: Perfect. Closing this thread — huge thanks everyone :tada:
